operations.message: Reached tail node 40. In a valid circular list, tail→next should point back to head (n1 = 10). But it points to NULL!
BROKEN CIRCULAR REFERENCE: tail node 40 has next = NULL instead of pointing back to head (10). The list is no longer circular — any traversal expecting to loop will terminate here instead.

errors.message: Tail node (value=40) has next=NULL. A circular linked list must have tail→next = head. This breaks all circular traversal logic.
